baseline: Current PostgreSQL application store; existing customer identity, authoring, signed credits and individual staff session boundaries

execution_policy.server_operation: User-controlled terminal restart; no competing project server
execution_policy.customer_data: Synthetic customers and separate PostgreSQL database for mutation tests
execution_policy.frontend_parallel_work: Freeze event and authorization contracts first; final integration source fingerprint at WAC-09
execution_policy.completion: WAC-01 through WAC-09 accepted; zero blocking security, integrity or regression defects
execution_policy.scope_changes: Blocking defects stay in scope; unrelated convenience improvements go to a subsequent release
execution_policy.real_commerce: Coming soon; activation is a separate commercial gate, not a blocker for this implementation

stages.title: Reuse inventory, permissions and event contracts
deliverables: Allowlisted versioned event and command DTOs
acceptance: Every required business domain has an authoritative source and attribution key
No implicit private content access or system-token escalation

stages.title: PostgreSQL migration and transactional event collection
deliverables: Transactional audit/outbox and private operation links
Bounded historical backfill and ingestion health
acceptance: Business and required audit/outbox commit or roll back together
Worker restart and duplicate delivery do not duplicate effects
No invented historical auth or AI events

stages.title: Unified overview, customer detail and organization timeline
deliverables: Authorized links to existing specialist menus
acceptance: Current source state agrees across linked menus
Session revocation and tenant boundaries apply to list, detail, cursor and cache paths
No private prompts or outputs in default views

stages.title: AI generation, workflow and package lifecycle monitoring
deliverables: Generation latency, cache and failure status
Saved version to execution, release, deployment and package links
acceptance: Retry attempts and cache hits do not inflate business success counts
Unknown is preserved and cannot trigger unsafe redispatch
Package issuance is not described as recipient download completion

stages.title: Credit reconciliation and reviewed corrections
deliverables: Coming-soon payment/subscription state and sandbox isolation
acceptance: Welcome grant, save and post-download revision policies remain unchanged
Duplicate or concurrent corrections have one effect
Restore review blocks cannot be bypassed
No real commerce activation or TEST_UNIT/customer-credit mixing

stages.title: Customer cases, constrained actions and support disclosures
stages.owner_role: Customer support product, backend and security
deliverables: Assignment, internal notes, reply drafts and case lifecycle
Scoped session revocation and access restriction commands
acceptance: General tickets remain distinct from execution support evaluations
Internal notes and private content cannot leak through customer replies
Every mutation has current authorization, revision, reason and idempotency
External delivery requires verified destination and purpose authorization

stages.title: Incidents, ingestion health and operational audit
deliverables: Safe error grouping and affected-customer counts
Ingestion lag, loss and reconciliation alerts
acceptance: Missing observations cannot appear as zero activity or healthy operation
Incident resolution does not silently close customer cases
Unknown execution outcomes remain distinct from failure and success

stages.title: Performance, retention, restoration and security verification
deliverables: Representative PostgreSQL query and worker measurements
Static and isolated dynamic security evidence
acceptance: Existing and fresh database migrations pass
No tenant, session, CSRF, XSS, export or command privilege bypass
Restore cannot replay commands or resurrect credits/approvals
Latency and completeness measurements show actual values and limits

stages.title: Final integration, operating acceptance and scope closure
deliverables: User-controlled restart and operating read smoke
Acceptance record and separate future-commerce gates
acceptance: All required scenarios accepted with zero blocking defects
No regression in login, authoring, credits or existing admin menus
No real-customer mutation without scoped approval
WAC-1.0 marked complete only with implementation and acceptance evidence
